title: Bears and Juice
statementMd:
There are $*n*$ bears in the inn and $*p*$ places to sleep. Bears will party together for some number of nights (and days).

Bears love drinking juice. They don't like wine but they can't distinguish it from juice by taste or smell.

A bear doesn't sleep unless he drinks wine. A bear must go to sleep a few hours after drinking a wine. He will wake up many days after the party is over.

Radewoosh is the owner of the inn. He wants to put some number of barrels in front of bears. One barrel will contain wine and all other ones will contain juice. Radewoosh will challenge bears to find a barrel with wine.

Each night, the following happens in this exact order:

1. Each bear must choose a (maybe empty) set of barrels. The same barrel may be chosen by many bears.
2. Each bear drinks a glass from each barrel he chose.
3. All bears who drink wine go to sleep (exactly those bears who chose a barrel with wine). They will wake up many days after the party is over. If there are not enough places to sleep then bears lose immediately.

At the end, if it's sure where wine is and there is at least one awake bear then bears win (unless they have lost before because of the number of places to sleep).

Radewoosh wants to allow bears to win. He considers $*q*$ scenarios. In the $*i*$-th scenario the party will last for $*i*$ nights. Then, let $*R*_{*i*}$ denote the maximum number of barrels for which bears surely win if they behave optimally. Let's define ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/aa85ca4caef891acc09b71a549d14e5ac2d80746.png). Your task is to find ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a9508034c6074683459bbbd26844e1b3e9b41d5e.png), where ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c4b7092c0f7ce6535f2574569c98f7b3c2fe2c5f.png) denotes the exclusive or (also denoted as XOR).

Note that the same barrel may be chosen by many bears and all of them will go to sleep at once.

## Input

The only line of the input contains three integers $*n*$, $*p*$ and $*q*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{9}$, $1 ≤ *p* ≤ 130$, $1 ≤ *q* ≤ 2 000 000$) — the number of bears, the number of places to sleep and the number of scenarios, respectively.

## Output

Print one integer, equal to ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a9508034c6074683459bbbd26844e1b3e9b41d5e.png).

## Note

In the first sample, there are $5$ bears and only $1$ place to sleep. We have $*R*_{1} = 6, *R*_{2} = 11, *R*_{3} = 16$ so the answer is ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b3272ae710321a0a8ceffa5d8c9afe3bf54e75eb.png). Let's analyze the optimal strategy for scenario with $2$ days. There are $*R*_{2} = 11$ barrels and $10$ of them contain juice.

- In the first night, the $*i*$-th bear chooses a barrel $*i*$ only.
- If one of the first $5$ barrels contains wine then one bear goes to sleep. Then, bears win because they know where wine is and there is at least one awake bear.
  - But let's say none of the first $5$ barrels contains wine. In the second night, the $*i*$-th bear chooses a barrel $5 + *i*$.
  - If one of barrels $6 – 10$ contains wine then one bear goes to sleep. And again, bears win in such a situation.
    - If nobody went to sleep then wine is in a barrel $11$.

In the second sample, there is only one bear. He should choose an empty set of barrels in each night. Otherwise, he would maybe get wine and bears would lose (because there must be at least one awake bear). So, for any number of days we have $*R*_{*i*} = 1$. The answer is ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c8b4cc3bcaf1329398e221289359b01c0a392ec5.png).
statementZhMd:
有 $*n*$ 只熊住在旅馆里，而旅馆有 $*p*$ 个睡觉的位置。熊们将一起聚会若干个夜晚（以及白天）。

熊喜欢喝果汁。他们不喜欢葡萄酒，但无法通过味道或气味将葡萄酒与果汁区分开。

熊只有喝了葡萄酒才会睡觉。熊喝下葡萄酒几小时后必须去睡觉。他将在聚会结束许多天后才醒来。

旅馆老板 Radewoosh 想在熊面前放置若干个木桶。其中一个木桶装有葡萄酒，其余木桶都装有果汁。Radewoosh 要求熊找出装有葡萄酒的木桶。

每个晚上，以下事件会按照严格的顺序发生：

1. 每只熊必须选择一些木桶组成的集合（也可以为空）。同一个木桶可以被许多只熊选择。
2. 每只熊从自己选择的每个木桶中喝一杯。
3. 所有喝到葡萄酒的熊都会去睡觉（恰好是选择了装有葡萄酒的木桶的那些熊）。它们将在聚会结束许多天后醒来。如果没有足够的睡觉位置，熊立即失败。

在聚会结束时，如果熊能够确定葡萄酒所在的位置，并且至少有一只醒着的熊，那么熊就获胜（除非它们之前因为睡觉位置的数量而失败）。

Radewoosh 想让熊获胜。他考虑 $*q*$ 个场景。在第 $*i*$ 个场景中，聚会将持续 $*i*$ 个夜晚。令 $*R*_{*i*}$ 表示在熊采取最优策略时，能够保证熊获胜的木桶数量的最大值。定义 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/aa85ca4caef891acc09b71a549d14e5ac2d80746.png)。你的任务是求出 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a9508034c6074683459bbbd26844e1b3e9b41d5e.png)，其中 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c4b7092c0f7ce6535f2574569c98f7b3c2fe2c5f.png) 表示排他或（也称为 XOR）。

注意，同一个木桶可以被许多只熊选择，并且它们会同时睡着。

## 输入格式

输入仅一行，包含三个整数 $*n*$、$*p*$ 和 $*q*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{9}$，$1 ≤ *p* ≤ 130$，$1 ≤ *q* ≤ 2 000 000$）——分别表示熊的数量、睡觉位置的数量以及场景的数量。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数，等于 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a9508034c6074683459bbbd26844e1b3e9b41d5e.png)。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，有 $5$ 只熊且只有 $1$ 个睡觉位置。我们有 $*R*_{1} = 6, *R*_{2} = 11, *R*_{3} = 16$，因此答案为 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b3272ae710321a0a8ceffa5d8c9afe3bf54e75eb.png)。下面分析持续 $2$ 天的场景中的最优策略。共有 $*R*_{2} = 11$ 个木桶，其中 $10$ 个装有果汁。

- 第一晚，第 $*i*$ 只熊只选择木桶 $*i*$。
- 如果前 $5$ 个木桶中有一个装有葡萄酒，那么一只熊会去睡觉。此时熊就获胜了，因为它们知道葡萄酒在哪里，并且至少还有一只醒着的熊。
  - 但是，假设前 $5$ 个木桶中没有一个装有葡萄酒。在第二晚，第 $*i*$ 只熊选择木桶 $5 + *i*$。
  - 如果木桶 $6 – 10$ 中有一个装有葡萄酒，那么一只熊会去睡觉。在这种情况下，熊同样会获胜。
    - 如果没有熊去睡觉，那么葡萄酒就在木桶 $11$ 中。

在第二个样例中，只有一只熊。他应该在每个晚上都选择空的木桶集合。否则，他可能会喝到葡萄酒，导致熊失败（因为必须至少有一只醒着的熊）。因此，对于任意天数，都有 $*R*_{*i*} = 1$。答案为 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c8b4cc3bcaf1329398e221289359b01c0a392ec5.png)。
